message.content: The evidence is decisive: claim c1 is confirmed with a runtime probe on the exact in-scope workload showing E = 1.4552e-3 > 1e-3 (finite outputs, ||ref||_2 = 0.2456), with the FP32-only simulation (E ~ 1.09e-6) isolating the FP16 rounding of softmax probabilities at kernel.py line 15 as the sole cause. Claim c2 is rebutted. The contract explicitly permits reduced precision only if the E ≤ 0.001 budget is met — it is not. The Skeptic has signed off with no new claims, and no open claims remain.
